interaction_nodes.summary: This card counters a target spell unless its controller pays {X}, and if the spell is countered, it is exiled instead of going to the graveyard.
interaction_nodes.text: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {X}. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.

interaction_nodes.name: Unsubstantiate
interaction_nodes.summary: Unsubstantiate returns a target spell or creature to its owner's hand, disrupting the opponent's plans.
interaction_nodes.text: Return target spell or creature to its owner's hand.
hooks: Return target spell or creature to its owner's hand

interaction_nodes.name: Curse of the Swine
interaction_nodes.summary: The spell exiles X target creatures, creating a 2/2 green Boar creature token for each creature exiled, potentially disrupting the opponent's board while providing a small creature token.
interaction_nodes.text: Exile X target creatures. For each creature exiled this way, its controller creates a 2/2 green Boar creature token.

interaction_nodes.name: Rewind
interaction_nodes.summary: Rewind counters a target spell and untaps up to four lands, providing both disruption and ramp benefits.
interaction_nodes.text: Counter target spell. Untap up to four lands.
hooks: Zone: Stack -> Hand (effectively, as the countered spell is sent to its owner's hand)

interaction_nodes.name: Rapid Hybridization
interaction_nodes.summary: Rapid Hybridization destroys a target creature and prevents regeneration while providing a 3/3 Frog Lizard token to the creature's controller.
interaction_nodes.text: Destroy target creature. It can't be regenerated. That creature's controller creates a 3/3 green Frog Lizard creature token.

interaction_nodes.name: Electrodominance
interaction_nodes.summary: Electrodominance deals X damage to any target and allows casting a spell with mana value X or less from your hand without paying its mana cost, enabling powerful synergies.
interaction_nodes.text: Electrodominance deals X damage to any target. You may cast a spell with mana value X or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.

interaction_nodes.name: Arcane Denial
interaction_nodes.summary: Arcane Denial counters a target spell and provides a card draw benefit to both the controller of the countered spell and the caster at the beginning of the next upkeep.
interaction_nodes.text:
Counter target spell. Its controller may draw up to two cards at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
You draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
hooks: Draw up to two cards at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep

interaction_nodes.name: Narset's Reversal
interaction_nodes.summary: Narset's Reversal copies a target instant or sorcery spell and returns the original to its owner's hand, potentially disrupting their plans and giving the controller of Narset's Reversal an extra action.
interaction_nodes.text: Copy target instant or sorcery spell, then return it to its owner's hand. You may choose new targets for the copy.

interaction_nodes.name: Reiterate
interaction_nodes.summary: Reiterate allows for the copying of an instant or sorcery spell with the option to choose new targets, and offers the buyback option to return the card to the hand upon resolution.
interaction_nodes.text:
Buyback {3} (You may pay an additional {3} as you cast this spell. If you do, put this card into your hand as it resolves.)
Copy target instant or sorcery spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.

interaction_nodes.name: Aria of Flame
interaction_nodes.summary: Aria of Flame grants opponents life upon entering the battlefield and deals damage to a target player or planeswalker whenever the controller casts an instant or sorcery spell, scaling with the number of verse counters.
interaction_nodes.text:
When this enchantment enters, each opponent gains 10 life.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, put a verse counter on this enchantment, then it deals damage equal to the number of verse counters on it to target player or planeswalker.

interaction_nodes.name: Mystical Tutor
interaction_nodes.summary: Mystical Tutor allows a player to search their library for an instant or sorcery card, revealing it, then shuffling the library and putting the card on top, effectively providing card advantage by finding desired cards.
interaction_nodes.text: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.

interaction_nodes.name: Muddle the Mixture
interaction_nodes.summary: Counters a targeted instant or sorcery spell, and provides an alternative discard cost to search for a card with the same mana value, revealing and putting it into hand.
interaction_nodes.text:
Counter target instant or sorcery spell.
Transmute {1}{U}{U} ({1}{U}{U}, Discard this card: Search your library for a card with the same mana value as this card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Transmute only as a sorcery.)

interaction_nodes.name: Fervent Mastery
interaction_nodes.summary: Fervent Mastery allows an opponent to discard and draw an equal number of cards, while the player searches their library for up to three cards to put into their hand and then discards three cards at random.
interaction_nodes.text:
You may pay {2}{R}{R} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
If the {2}{R}{R} cost was paid, an opponent discards any number of cards, then draws that many cards.
Search your library for up to three cards, put them into your hand, shuffle, then discard three cards at random.
hooks: Variable X Scaling (number of cards discarded/drawn)

interaction_nodes.name: Solve the Equation
interaction_nodes.summary: Searches the library for an instant or sorcery card, reveals it, puts it into the hand, and shuffles the library, providing direct card advantage.
interaction_nodes.text: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

interaction_nodes.name: Quiet Speculation
interaction_nodes.summary: The card enables searching a player's library for up to three cards with flashback and putting them into the graveyard, which indirectly aids in controlling the graveyard and potentially setting up for future plays.
interaction_nodes.text: Search target player's library for up to three cards with flashback and put them into that player's graveyard. Then the player shuffles.

interaction_nodes.name: Intuition
interaction_nodes.summary: Intuition allows the player to search their library for three cards, with an opponent choosing one to be put into the player's hand while the others go to the graveyard, effectively drawing a card.
interaction_nodes.text: Search your library for three cards and reveal them. Target opponent chooses one. Put that card into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. Then shuffle.

interaction_nodes.name: Gifts Ungiven
interaction_nodes.summary: Gifts Ungiven allows the player to manipulate their library, putting chosen cards into their graveyard and the rest into their hand, providing significant card advantage.
interaction_nodes.text: Search your library for up to four cards with different names and reveal them. Target opponent chooses two of those cards. Put the chosen cards into your graveyard and the rest into your hand. Then shuffle.

interaction_nodes.name: Mystic Retrieval
interaction_nodes.summary: Returns an instant or sorcery card from the graveyard to your hand and can be cast from the graveyard with flashback, providing additional card manipulation opportunities.
interaction_nodes.text:
Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Flashback {2}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

interaction_nodes.name: Past in Flames
interaction_nodes.summary: Enables the casting of instants and sorcery cards from your graveyard by granting them flashback until end of turn, providing a disruption-heavy toolbox.
interaction_nodes.text:
Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.
Flashback {4}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

interaction_nodes.name: Underworld Breach
interaction_nodes.summary: Underworld Breach grants escape to nonland cards in the graveyard, allowing them to be cast from the graveyard for a specified cost, which includes exiling three other cards from the graveyard.
interaction_nodes.text:
Each nonland card in your graveyard has escape. The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile three other cards from your graveyard. (You may cast cards from your graveyard for their escape cost.)
At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this enchantment.

interaction_nodes.name: Brain Freeze
interaction_nodes.summary: The card mills three cards from a target player's library, with the potential to create multiple copies of itself if other spells were cast before it this turn.
interaction_nodes.text:
Target player mills three cards.
Storm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.)
